subject: Fix RDMA build dependence (#1074)
reason: The change is a one-line Makefile fix: the valkey-rdma.so target's prerequisite is corrected from the stale $(REDIS_SERVER_NAME) variable to $(SERVER_NAME). It only affects build dependency ordering for the optional RDMA module and changes no runtime behaviour, command replies, replication, or persistence; there is nothing a running-server scenario could exercise.
